reasons.plausibility: The proposed short-range ordering mechanism influencing fault energies and promoting twinning is well-grounded in current understanding of multicomponent alloy behavior.
reasons.testability: The controlled thermal treatment and direct microstructural and mechanical characterizations provide a clear, decisive means to verify or refute the hypothesis.
